REJECTED.title: Your application was not selected
REJECTED.body: {companyName} did not select your application to "{offerTitle}".

REMOVED.title: Your offer "{offerTitle}" was removed
REMOVED.body: An administrator removed it from the portal. Reason: {reason}

RESTORED.title: Your offer "{offerTitle}" was restored
RESTORED.body: An administrator restored it; it is visible again.

DEACTIVATED.title: Your account was deactivated
DEACTIVATED.body: An administrator deactivated your account. Reason: {reason}

ACTIVATED.title: Your account was reactivated
ACTIVATED.body: An administrator reactivated your account. You can use the portal again.
